name: adhd
description: Shapes assistant output for a reader with ADHD: action-first and low-friction. adhd:shape is a standing session posture: lead with the next action, number steps, restate state across turns, cap and rank lists, give time estimates, cut preamble. adhd:clarify reshapes one dense, decision-heavy message: one decision at a time, jargon defined, operative terms quoted verbatim, with an HTML decision table for big content. Reauthored in part from ayghri/i-have-adhd (MIT).
